en: From BBC Learning English, this is Learning English from the News, our podcast about the news headlines.
zh: 這裡是BBC英語學習頻道推出的「 新聞英語學習」 播客，內容是關於新聞頭條的。

en: In this programme, climate talks fail.
zh: 在這個節目中，氣候談判失敗了。

en: What went wrong?
zh: 哪裡出了問題？

notes.zh: don't take this the wrong way：別誤會我的意思（說真話前超實用緩衝句）
notes.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but the second version reads better.

en: Hello, I'm Pippa. And I'm Becca.
zh: 你好，我是皮帕。我是貝卡。

en: In this programme, we look at one big news story and the vocabulary in the headlines that will help you understand it.
zh: 在本節目中，我們將分析一則重大新聞事件，並講解新聞標題中的詞彙，以幫助您理解該事件。

en: You can find all the vocabulary and headlines from this episode,
zh: 您可以在我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上找到本集的所有詞彙和標題，

en: as well as a free worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 以及免費練習題。

en: So let's hear more about this story.
zh: 那麼，讓我們來詳細了解這個故事。

en: Countries have failed to reach an agreement to deal with the problem of climate change
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: after disagreements over fossil fuels and money at climate talks in Turkey.
zh: 在土耳其舉行的氣候談判中，各國因化石燃料和資金問題產生分歧，未能就應對氣候變遷達成協議。

en: The COP31 talks were the latest in a yearly conference between UN nations
zh: COP31 會議是聯合國各國

en: to plan and agree commitments and action on climate change.
zh: 為規劃和商定應對氣候變遷的承諾和行動而舉行的年度會議的最新一次。

en: This was the longest climate conference ever, but the talks collapsed on Sunday
zh: 這是有史以來持續時間最長的氣候大會，但

notes.example: The star collapsed inward once its fuel ran dry.

en: after countries were unable to reach an agreement.
zh: 由於各國未能達成協議，談判於週日破裂。

en: Let's have our first headline.
zh: 讓我們來看看第一個新聞標題。

en: This is from the New York Times.
zh: 這是《紐約時報》的報導。

en: U.N. Climate Talks Collapse in a Bitter Clash Over Fossil Fuels.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: And that headline, again from the New York Times.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: U.N. Climate Talks Collapse in a Bitter Clash Over Fossil Fuels.
zh: 聯合國氣候談判因化石燃料問題爆發激烈衝突而破裂。這則新聞標題同樣來自《紐約時報》。聯合國氣候談判因化石燃料問題爆發激烈衝突而破裂。

en: This headline is about the collapse of the talks and the clash, or disagreement, between countries.
zh: 這則新聞標題是關於談判破裂以及各國之間的衝突或分歧。

en: We're interested in the description of the clash as bitter.
zh: 我們感興趣的是將這場衝突描述為激烈的。

en: Bitter literally describes a taste that can be sharp or unpleasant.
zh: 苦味字面意思是形容一種辛辣或令人不快的味道。

en: For example, very strong coffee could be described as bitter. Right.
zh: 例如，非常濃的咖啡可能會被形容為苦澀。正確的。

en: But we use bitter metaphorically to describe things other than tastes,
zh: 但是，我們用「苦澀」作比喻來描述味道以外的事物，

en: and then it means unpleasant and involving a lot of anger or unhappiness.
zh: 這時它的意思是不愉快的，並且包含很多憤怒或不快樂。

en: So, for example, my friends recently had a very bitter argument.
zh: 例如，我的朋友們最近發生了一場非常激烈的爭吵。他們倆都非常

en: They were both very angry with each other, and they didn't speak for a few weeks.
zh: 生氣，好幾個星期都沒說話。

en: In the headline, the clash at the climate talks is described as bitter.
zh: 標題將氣候談判中的衝突描述為激烈的。

en: This means it was unpleasant and involved anger and unhappiness from the countries who couldn't agree.
zh: 這意味著過程令人不快，無法達成協議的國家對此感到憤怒和不滿。

en: We can also use bitter to describe someone who is angry and unhappy for a long time about something that happened in the past.
zh: 我們也可以用 bitter 來形容某人因為過去發生的事情而長期感到憤怒和不快樂。

en: For example, the employee was very bitter after the company fired him.
zh: 例如，這名員工被公司解僱後非常憤恨。

en: He never recovered.
zh: 他再也沒能康復。

notes.zh: better late than never：亡羊補牢猶未晚也
notes.example: I finally started exercising—better late than never!

en: We've had bitter, unpleasant, involving anger or unhappiness.
zh: 我們經歷過痛苦、不愉快、牽涉其中的憤怒或不快樂。

en: For example, my friend is in a bitter dispute with his neighbour about some building work.
zh: 例如，我的朋友正與鄰居就一些建築工程發生激烈的爭執。

en: It sounds horrible.
zh: 聽起來太可怕了。

en: This is Learning English from the News, our podcast about the news headlines.
zh: 這裡是《從新聞中學習英文》，我們的播客節目，內容是關於新聞頭條的。今天我們來談談重要的

en: Today we're talking about the failure of important international climate talks.
zh: 國際氣候談判的失敗。

en: So, why did the COP31 talks end without an agreement?
zh: 那麼，為什麼COP31談判最後沒有達成協議？

en: Well, there are two main reasons.
zh: 主要原因有兩個。首先，

en: First, many countries, including EU countries and Pacific island nations
zh: 包括歐盟國家和太平洋島國在內的許多國家

en: were unhappy because the draft agreement didn't include the term fossil fuels.
zh: 感到不滿，因為協議草案中沒有包含「化石燃料」一詞。

en: This is things like oil and gas.
zh: 這包括石油和天然氣之類的東西。

en: These countries believed an agreement about climate change needed to include a commitment to use fossil fuels less in the future.
zh: 這些國家認為，關於氣候變遷的協議需要包含未來減少化石燃料使用的承諾

en: The other disagreement was over payments to poorer countries to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.
zh: 。另一個分歧點在於向較貧窮的國家支付款項，以幫助它們適應氣溫上升的影響。

en: Many of these countries wanted the agreement to say exactly how much financial help richer countries would commit to.
zh: 許多國家希望該協議明確規定較富裕國家將承諾提供多少財政援助。我們再擬定一個標題

en: Let's have another headline.
zh: 。這段文字

en: This is from The Guardian, a UK newspaper.
zh: 摘自英國報紙《衛報》。

en: Cop31 draft climate text dissected: what it says and what it means.
zh: 剖析COP31

en: And that headline, again from the Guardian. Cop31
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: draft climate text dissected: what it says and what it means.
zh: 氣候草案文本：內容及其意義。

en: This headline is about the draft agreement at the talks, which countries couldn't agree on.
zh: 這則新聞標題同樣來自《衛報》。剖析COP31氣候草案文本：內容及其意義。這則新聞標題是關於會談中各國未能就協議草案達成一致的內容。

en: We're interested in this word dissected.
zh: 我們對這個字的剖析很感興趣。

en: What does it mean to dissect something, Becca?
zh: 貝卡，解剖某物是什麼意思？

en: Well, the verb dissect means separate into smaller parts so that you can look at something in more detail.
zh: 動詞 dissect 的意思是將某物分解成更小的部分，以便更詳細地觀察它。

en: You might have dissected an insect or an animal when you were at school.
zh: 你可能在學校的時候解剖過昆蟲或動物。

en: It involves carefully cutting it up to look at different parts and how they fit together.
zh: 這需要仔細地將其切割開，觀察不同的部分以及它們是如何組合在一起的。

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: We can dissect things like texts too, and that's the meaning in the headline.
zh: 我們也可以像分析文本一樣分析事物，這就是標題的意思。

en: It means the writer is going to separate the draft climate agreement into smaller parts to understand what it means.
zh: 這意味著作者將把氣候協議草案拆分成更小的部分，以便理解其意義。

en: We use dissect in a similar way to the verb analyse.
zh: 我們使用 dissect 的方式與動詞 analyse 類似。

en: And so you might hear it in any situation where someone wants to look in more detail at something.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: So, for example, at work you might want to dissect the company's sales results
zh: 因此，在任何有人想要更詳細地了解某件事的情況下，你可能會聽到這句話。例如，在工作中，你可能想要分析公司的銷售業績，

en: to see what's going well and what's going badly.
zh: 看看哪些方面做得好，哪些方面做得不好。

en: And in a more relaxed context.
zh: 而且是在更輕鬆的環境下。

en: I call my friend every weekend after our favourite TV show is on, to dissect what happened and what we think might happen next.
zh: 每個週末，在我們最喜歡的電視節目

en: We've had dissect, separate into small parts to look at more closely.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: For example, the couple went to counselling to dissect what was going wrong in their relationship.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

notes.zh: don't take this the wrong way：別誤會我的意思（說真話前超實用緩衝句）
notes.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but the second version reads better.

en: This is Learning English from the News from BBC Learning English.
zh: 播出後，我都會打電話給我的朋友，一起分析劇情發展以及我們認為接下來可能會發生的事情。我們已經進行了解剖，將物體分成小部分以便更仔細地觀察。例如，這對夫婦接受了諮詢，以分析他們的關係中出了什麼問題。這是來自BBC英語學習頻道的「新聞英語學習」節目。我們正在討論的是COP31

en: We're talking about the failure of COP31 climate talks.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: After the climate talks failed to reach an agreement, a lot of people have been asking what this means for the future
zh: 氣候談判的失敗。氣候談判未能達成協議後，

en: of dealing with climate change.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Whilst there wasn't an overall agreement between countries at the conference, experts say progress was made in other areas.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: And the failure to reach an agreement doesn't mean climate action stops.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Much of it relies on private companies.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: But many people believe the failure of the talks means that
zh: 許多人都在問，這對未來應對氣候變遷意味著什麼。儘管各國在會議上沒有達成全面協議，但專家表示，在其他領域取得了進展。即使未能達成協議，也不代表氣候行動就此停止。其中很大一部分依賴私人公司。但許多人認為，會談的失敗意味著

en: the way countries work together to act on the climate needs to change.
zh: 各國在應對氣候變遷方面的合作方式需要改變。先前聯合國

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: Previous UN climate talks have led to important agreements,
zh: 氣候談判達成了一些重要協議，

en: such as the commitment to keep global warming to 1.5C,
zh: 例如承諾將全球暖化控制在攝氏 1.5 度以內，但批評人士表示，

notes.zh: keep up：跟上腳步／跟上進度
notes.example: Walk a little slower—I can barely keep up!

en: but critics say disagreements now will mean action doesn't happen fast enough.
zh: 目前的分歧意味著行動速度不夠快。

en: Let's have another headline.
zh: 我們再擬定一個標題。

en: This is from New Scientist, a science news magazine.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: COP31 collapse has shattered the pretence of a global climate consensus.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: And that headline, again from New Scientist. COP31 collapse has shattered the pretence of a global climate consensus.
zh: 這段文字摘自科學新聞雜誌《新科學家》。 COP31 的失敗粉碎了全球氣候共識的假象。

en: This headline says the failure of the talks has shattered, or broken,
zh: 這條標題同樣來自《新科學家》雜誌。 COP31 的失敗粉碎了

en: the pretence of a global consensus, and consensus means agreement.
zh: 全球氣候共識的假象。

en: We're interested in this word pretence.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Yes, Pippa. Pretence is when a person or a group of people pretend something, when in reality it's not true.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: So, in this story, the headline says the talks have broken the pretence of agreement on climate change.
zh: 這則新聞標題說，談判的失敗打破了全球共識的假象，而共識意味著達成一致。我們對這種文字偽裝很感興趣。是的，皮帕。偽裝是指一個人或一群人假裝做某件事，但實際上並非如此。所以，這篇報導的標題是：談判打破了氣候變遷議題上達成協議的假象。這

en: This means that previous climate agreements have made it appear that countries are united on dealing with climate change,
zh: 意味著先前的氣候協議使各國在應對氣候變遷方面看起來團結一致，

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: but these talks have shown they actually disagree about a lot of things.
zh: 但這些談判表明，他們實際上在許多問題上存在分歧。我們有

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: We have a couple of common phrases with pretence. We can talk
zh: 一些關於偽裝的常用短語。我們可以談談

en: about keeping up a pretence, which means continue pretending something.
zh: 維持假象，也就是繼續假裝做某件事。

en: For example, the teenager was expelled from school, but he left home in his uniform every morning to keep up the pretence
zh: 例如，這名青少年被學校開除，但他每天早上都穿著校服出門，以維持假象，

notes.zh: keep up：跟上腳步／跟上進度
notes.example: Walk a little slower—I can barely keep up!

en: so his parents wouldn't find out.
zh: 以免父母發現真相。 「

en: And the phrase make no pretence means to not pretend anything.
zh: 不裝腔作勢」這個短語的意思是不要假裝任何事情。

en: For example, when my sister tells me a boring story, I make no pretence of actually listening to what she says.
zh: 例如，當我的妹妹告訴我一個無聊的故事時，我根本不會假裝認真聽她講什麼。

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: We've had pretence, the act of pretending something is true when it's not.
zh: 我們一直以來都有偽裝，也就是假裝某件事是真的，但實際上並非如此。

en: For example, you can stop with the pretence.
zh: 例如，你可以停止偽裝。

en: I know you've organised a surprise birthday party for me.
zh: 我知道你為我準備了一個驚喜生日派對。本期《

en: That's it for this episode of Learning English from the News.
zh: 從新聞中學習英語》節目到此結束。

en: We'll be back next week with another news story.
zh: 下週我們將繼續為您帶來另一則新聞報道。

en: If you're interested in stories about the climate, head to our website
zh: 如果您對氣候相關新聞感興趣，請訪問我們的網站，

en: where we have a topic page all about the environment and climate change.
zh: 我們有一個專門介紹環境和氣候變遷的專題頁面。網址是

en: It's at bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: bbclearningenglish.com。

en: Bye for now. Bye.
zh: 暫時再見。再見。
